narration:
Your GOOG thesis is waiting. It's still on step 1, and a recent event knocked out the pivot it was leaning on.

The thesis (saved 18 Nov) has two steps. Step 1 is the next confirmed daily cycle low, at any price. Step 2 is either a higher daily cycle low or a bullish daily trend-line break.

What happened:
- On 21 Oct, the 1 Oct daily cycle low (332.65) failed. GOOG closed below it. That was before you saved the thesis, so it doesn't count.
- On 5 Nov, a daily cycle low was confirmed at 276.2. DWLF only knew this on 11 Nov, which is also before the save, so it doesn't count for step 1.
- On 19 Nov, that 276.2 low failed. GOOG closed below it. This pivot no longer stands, and it is the latest event.

Where it stands now: the last close, on 19 Nov, was 271.02. Neither step is met. GOOG is inside its weekly cycle low window, which opened 26 Oct and closes around 4 Jan. The centre of that window is about 23 Nov. The engine only estimates these window dates, and they are unverified.

What step 1 needs: a new confirmed daily cycle low dated after 5 Nov, learned after the thesis was set. Once that happens, DWLF checks step 2. Another daily close below the latest confirmed daily cycle low would challenge the thesis.

The story has no saved plan for this revision. It describes what has happened and what would meet each step. It isn't a forecast or advice. You can see it at https://dwlf.co.uk/theses/goog-example?story=now
